content:
I've been getting annoying workflow failure emails from my personal cslib fork:
https://github.com/ctchou/cslib/actions
I really don't see any reason why such workflows should run in my personal fork at all. How can I turn them off?
You can turn off all CI workflows in the repo settings on your fork

We also have if: github.repository == 'leanprover/cslib' in jobs that shouldn't run in forks. It looks like the new job for bumping Mathlib is missing this. I can't do it myself at the moment (limited wifi on a plane) but someone feel free to make a PR for this.
(if it isn't allowed directly under jobs, you might need to add it in both bump and open-issue separately)

Which file in .github/workflows is for bumping mathlib? I see the conditional line in bump_toolchain_nightly-testing.yml. For that matter, weekly-lints.yml has that line too, but I still see it being run in my fork: https://github.com/ctchou/cslib/actions

The job I'm referring to is lake-update.yml. With the conditional, like you see for weekly linting, how this works is that the job starts to run but immediately exits on checking the repo name. If you still prefer it does not run at all, do what Snir suggested and disable the job in your fork settings.
